Question 15
?

Find the function f(x) and the value of b, given that ∫−π/4bf(x)dx=limn→∞∑l=0n−1[sec2⁡(−π4+πl2n)⋅π2n].

a
f(x)=sec2⁡x and b=π3
b
f(x)=sec2⁡x and b=π4
c
f(x)=sec2⁡(x−π2) and b=π3
d
f(x)=sec2⁡(x−π2) and b=π4
e
f(x)=sec2⁡x and b=π6
Submit
